_source.title: 新增编辑器标签页事件监听
_source.remarks.text.0: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.1: 在 {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType | 标签页事件类型} 为 {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.CLOSE | 关闭} 或 {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.OPEN | 打开} 时，均会同时触发 {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.TOGGLE | 切换} 事件
_source.params.id: 事件 ID，用以防止重复注册事件
_source.params.callFn: 事件触发时的回调函数

title: Add an editor tab event listener
remarks.text.0: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.1: When the {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType | tab event type} is {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.CLOSE | close} or {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.OPEN | open}, the {@link EDMT_EditorTabEventType.TOGGLE | switch} event will also be triggered
params.id: Event ID, used to prevent duplicate event registration
params.callFn: The callback function triggered when the event fires
